description: This file defines the OrderStatusHistory entity class, which models historical changes to order statuses within an e-commerce system. It includes mappings to database columns and relationships to other entities such as Order, along with methods for accessing and modifying its fields.

classes.name: OrderStatusHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing the history of order status changes. Stores the order reference, status, timestamp of change, notification status, and comments.

methods.name: OrderStatusHistory
methods.description: Default constructor for the entity class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this status history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this status history record.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Assigns an Order object to this status history record.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Gets the current status of the order at this history point.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the order status for this history record.

methods.name: getDateAdded
methods.description: Returns the date when this status was added, cloned to prevent external modification.

methods.name: setDateAdded
methods.description: Sets the date when this status was added, cloning the input date.

methods.name: getCustomerNotified
methods.description: Retrieves the notification status (integer) for the customer regarding this status change.

methods.name: setCustomerNotified
methods.description: Sets the notification status for the customer.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Gets the comments associated with this status change.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments for this status history record.
